question: In November 2022, who among the following was appointed as the brand ambassador of Uttarakhand government?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Prasoon Joshi__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Uttarakhand government** has appointed Padma Shri awardee Prasoon Joshi, the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of McCann Worldgroup India as its brand ambassador. 
 
• Prasoon Joshi is a lyricist, writer, and artist native of Almora, Uttarakhand.
 
• He is currently serving as the Chairman of the Central Board of Film Certification (Censor Board). 
 
• He is the recipient of the Padma Shri award, the 4th highest civilian award for arts in 2015, and has also received several prestigious international honors including Young Global Leader by the World Economic Forum in 2006. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Padam Awards are given in three categories:

 
 
• Padma Vibhushan
 
• Padma Bhushan
 
• Padma Shri
 
 
 
• Padma Vibhushan is the highest of all.
 
• The awards are presented by the President of India at Rashtrapati Bhawan.
 
• ​The awards are given in various fields for example literature and education, art, social work, public affairs, science and engineering, trade and industry, medicine, sports, civil service, etc.
